items.text: Security updates installed in the last month
The screen locks by itself after a few idle minutes
Antivirus or endpoint protection is running and current
You work as a standard user, not as an administrator
MFA is on for your office email
No work files sit in personal cloud drives or messaging apps
You know whom to call if the device is lost
Your work files are backed up to approved storage
At home, your router's default password has been changed
